scope: Original synthetic corpus, host reference-library readback, and fixture integration tests.

corpus.origin: Original synthetic prose, vector geometry, and raster page.

environment.dependency_scope: Pinned direct packages; not a complete OS or transitive dependency lock.

command_convention: Commands ran from the repository root in PowerShell with the explicitly selected Python 3.13.14 executable. Its machine-local absolute path is normalized to python here. Arguments and result excerpts are retained; no personal path is required to reproduce them.

commands.command: python -X utf8 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_fixtures.py -v
commands.phase: Before generator, checker, or corpus existed
commands.interpretation: Expected assertion failures identified missing fixtures, manifest, generator, and checker. Imports succeeded.

commands.count_meaning: 42 fixture/engine pairs: four libraries for each of ten PDFs, plus ZIP/XML and MuPDF for one EPUB. Each pair has individually listed property comparisons.

commands.interpretation: The full discover command collected the 17 fixture tests present at this execution. Tests added subsequently by other lanes need their own integration run. The duration is unittest's wall-clock report, not a reader performance measurement.

commands.command: git diff --check -- scripts/generate_fixtures.py scripts/check_fixtures.py tests/test_fixtures.py fixtures knowledge/testing-fixtures.md evidence/fixture-verification.json
commands.limitation: Git diff does not inspect untracked additions; this result alone does not validate all new files.

resolved_development_findings.observation: The initial post-generation run reported four failures and thirty errors.
causes: PDFium page, text-page, and bitmap objects require explicit closing rather than native context-manager use.
MuPDF annotation handles require retaining their page object.
MuPDF exposes these /Fit destinations as named-link dictionaries with string page values; resolve_link on the actual URI returns the correct zero-based page.
The reference checker was not yet present when that run started.
resolved_development_findings.resolution: Corrected resource lifetimes and link resolution, completed the checker, and reran all tests without changing document bytes.

resolved_development_findings.observation: The first passing standalone reference check emitted pikepdf's Page.images deprecation warning.
resolved_development_findings.resolution: Changed to documented Page.get_images(), then reran the full suite and standalone checker. The final checker emitted no warning.

readback_coverage.text_extraction: All 114 PDF pages read by pypdf, MuPDF, and PDFium; expected anchors and text-layer presence checked.
readback_coverage.render_assertion: Nonblank grayscale extrema only; observed pixel hashes are not required to agree between engines.
readback_coverage.annotations: Six standard annotation types and note contents in pypdf, MuPDF, and qpdf.
readback_coverage.forms: Three unflattened widgets and initial values in pypdf, MuPDF, and qpdf; initial appearance dictionaries in qpdf.
readback_coverage.navigation: pypdf and MuPDF resolve both internal destinations; pypdf, MuPDF, and PDFium inspect the three outlines.
readback_coverage.password: Empty/wrong-password rejection and public user-password acceptance checked with all four PDF libraries.
readback_coverage.unicode: Literal precomposed accents and selected symbols; full embedded font SHA-256 and attached license read back independently by pypdf and MuPDF.
readback_coverage.epub: ZIP CRC and container/spine/navigation anchors, plus independent MuPDF extraction of both chapter markers.

reproducibility.verified: Two fresh output directories produced identical document bytes and identical manifests in the integration test.
reproducibility.identification: Use fixtures/manifest.json SHA-256 values for the actual distributed inputs.
reproducibility.stability_boundary: Same generator, reviewed font, and recorded toolchain. Cross-platform or dependency-version byte identity is not claimed.
reproducibility.metadata_epoch: 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z is an artificial fixed timestamp, not the authoring or observation date.
reproducibility.runtime_coordination: Generate into a new directory and communicate changed hashes before replacing inputs already used by a runtime investigation.

limitations: No Moon+ Reader, proprietary reader, Android emulator, or real-device workflow was tested by this lane.
A host-engine pass covers only listed checks; unchecked_expectations in the reference artifact explicitly identifies other manifest keys.
Nonblank renders do not establish visual fidelity, cross-engine equivalence, usability, or accessibility.
No performance, memory, OCR accuracy, form-edit persistence, or annotation round-trip claim is made.
Unicode scope is precomposed Latin accents and selected symbols; RTL, CJK, complex shaping, normalization, and emoji are not covered.
Encryption scope is legacy RC4-128 revision 3 with public test passwords, not AES or cryptographic-strength evaluation.
No damaged-document, PDF/A, PDF/UA, or complete EPUB-conformance validation is included.
Publication and tests added by other lanes remain the integration owner's responsibility.
